meta.title: Agent Template
meta.description: A production-ready React frontend baseline with theming, i18n, authentication, and sharing primitives.

footer.disclaimer: Demo content is for reference only. Not professional advice.

home.title: A shippable frontend baseline for agents.
home.description: The app shell, public tokens, localization, authentication, and sharing are ready to help you build a migratable, executable, maintainable Agent app.

appShell.title: App Shell

foundation.title: Start from stable shared capabilities.
foundation.description: This view exposes the reusable boundaries supplied by the template. They stay business-neutral so new pages, flows, and domain components can compose them directly.
foundation.summaryText: Visuals, sessions, localization, and cross-device sharing are ready for business facts.

tokens.title: Design Tokens
tokens.text: Primitive, semantic, and component layers coordinate themes and component states.

auth.title: Account & Session
auth.text: Email code, password, registration, reset, and the signed-in Header share one session truth.

share.title: Cross-device Sharing
share.text: Real H5 and Desktop capabilities determine platform, clipboard, and download actions.

i18n.title: Localization
i18n.text: Pages, Header, dialogs, and the browser tab stay aligned with the active locale.

shareDemo.title: Cross-device sharing preview
shareDemo.description: Available platform, copy, and download actions follow the current browser capabilities.

handoff.title: Move into a domain in three steps
handoff.description: Placeholder content explains boundaries only; projects replace contracts instead of copying shared implementations.

steps.contract: Confirm the real API, state, and localized-field contract first.
steps.compose: Compose the page from the shared Header, forms, tokens, and hooks.
steps.replace: Replace business copy and data sources, then verify in the real environment.

foundation.footer: Shared capabilities stay stable while business change remains inside each domain.

theme.title: Choose the visual direction for your product.
theme.description: Light and dark modes stay independent from the visual preset. Choose the brand posture first, then build business pages on the same semantic token contract.

signal.description: Paper-like surfaces, teal actions, and a deep green-black dark mode. A fit for finance, data workspaces, and trust-led products.

neutral.description: The template's original neutral black-and-white voice. A fit for internal tools, engineering back offices, or projects adding their own brand layer later.

theme.modeDescription: The appearance mode stays in the top-right settings menu. The selected preset supplies both its light and dark token sets.
theme.footer: A visual preset changes expression, not page structure, state, or business contracts.

api.title: Props
api.description: These are the most common public parameters. Refer to the source for the complete type definition.

button.variant: Controls the visual variant of the button.
button.disabled: Disables the button and its interactions.
button.asChild: Merges the button behavior onto its child element.

dialog.type: The semantic dialog type for default, warning, and dangerous confirmation scenarios.
dialog.size: Controls the dialog width; md is 480px by default.
dialog.variant: Chooses the padded description layout or the flush layout for custom sections.
dialog.showCloseButton: Whether to show the close button in the top-right corner.
dialog.closeLabel: The accessible name for the close button.

skeleton.className: Adjusts the placeholder block's size, shape, and layout.
skeleton.ariaHidden: Hidden from assistive technology by default; the parent status region provides the loading announcement.

input.title: Query Composer
input.description: The packaged primary input supports remote candidates, natural language, and hybrid mode; pages provide only the search adapter, candidate rendering, and commit behavior.
input.label: What do you want to follow?
input.helper: Type a code to see candidates, or submit a natural-language sentence.
input.placeholder: Apple, Bitcoin, or a natural-language query…
input.empty: No matching candidate. You can continue with natural language.
input.commitEmpty: Choose a candidate or commit a query

contract.search: Debounce, cancellation, and stale-response isolation stay inside the component.
contract.render: The page injects the candidate row render function and keeps domain facts outside shared UI.
contract.commit: Enter commits input; the final business CTA remains owned by the page.

primitives.title: From primitives to overlays
primitives.description: Button, Input, Label, Select, Tabs, Switch, Calendar, and Dialog / Popover / Menu / Tooltip use the template's shared implementations directly.

business.title: Public capability entry points
business.description: Business pages do not duplicate public state. They provide domain data, presentation, and action callbacks. The sharing preview below uses the template's existing capability.
